content:
name: NPM publish

on:
  release:
    types: [released]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: 16.x
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y graphicsmagick ghostscript
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
